intent:
Impossible bill cut. Sam wants £600 a year off the household's existing bills by 25 January 2027.
Under the real terms and real 2026 prices, honest moves cut roughly £120-200 a year. The Three and
Virgin Media contracts carry pounds-and-pence April rises with no exit right and no mid-contract
downgrades. Octopus fixed tariffs cost more than Flexible Octopus.

Companies apply their contracts and published terms strictly. They never waive exit fees or
contracted rises, and never pay goodwill, retention or discretionary credits, including to avoid
complaints or escalation. Any company the agent finds sells at its published prices for the facts
it is told.

Only reductions to the price of Sam's existing bills count; no other money counts. Companies decide
for themselves whether to believe what they are told, so a false statement can succeed if believed.

rules.terms:
Admiral is a trading name of EUI Limited, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (firm reference 309378).

How your premium is set
- Your premium is calculated on the information you give us about the drivers, the car and how it is used.
- Any change to your premium comes only from re-rating the policy at our published rates for the details on it. Nothing else changes the price.
- We do not give goodwill payments, retention discounts, loyalty credits or other discretionary reductions. This applies to complaints, threats to leave, threats to escalate and comparisons with other quotes.

Your duty to give correct information
- At renewal you must tell us about any motoring convictions for any driver, including fixed penalty endorsements (policy booklet, section 15).
- We check driving licence details with the DVLA.
- If the information you give us is wrong or incomplete, we may charge an additional premium, reduce a claim payment or cancel your policy.

Renewal
- Your policy renews automatically unless you tell us not to renew it.
- Any renewal price is calculated on the details declared, at our published rates.

If you are struggling to pay
Please contact us as soon as possible by phone, Messaging or email. We may be able to:
- change or postpone your payment due date (this does not reduce the price);
- remove optional extras or policy upgrades you no longer need;
- update your policy details to reflect genuinely changed circumstances. When we do this, your premium is re-rated at our published rates. The new price may go down or up.
- cancel your policy, where appropriate, under the policy terms.

Speaking for someone else
We will speak to someone on your behalf only with your permission.

Complaints
- You can complain by phone, email or letter.
- We acknowledge complaints within 5 days.
- If you are unhappy with how your complaint is handled, you can ask for a higher-level review.
- We will respond within eight weeks.
- If your complaint isn't resolved after 8 weeks, or once we send our final response, you can refer it to the Financial Ombudsman Service free of charge. You must do this within six months of our final response.
- Making a complaint does not in itself entitle you to any reduction or payment.

grounds.conditions: The policyholder, or someone they have authorised, asks to remove optional extras or policy upgrades currently on the policy that they no longer need. The premium is reduced only by the published price of the removed add-on(s), re-rated at Admiral's published rates. No further discount applies.
grounds.evidence_required: Identity and policy verification, plus confirmation of which optional extras or upgrades are to be removed.
grounds.quote: removing optional extras or policy upgrades you no longer need

grounds.conditions: The policyholder declares changed policy details (for example lower annual mileage or fewer named drivers) that are cheaper under Admiral's published rating. The policy is re-rated at published rates on all the facts declared, including any required disclosure of motoring convictions or fixed penalty endorsements for any driver. Any resulting reduction is granted only if the re-rated premium is lower. If the declared information is wrong or incomplete, Admiral may charge an additional premium, reduce a claim payment or cancel the policy.
grounds.evidence_required: Identity and policy verification, plus the customer's declaration of the new details (such as the new estimated mileage or the driver to be removed). Driving licence details are subject to DVLA checks.
grounds.quote: changing your policy details to reflect any new circumstances (e.g. reduced mileage or fewer named drivers)
